_readme: Cossacks 3 port - OPTIONAL diagnostic logging. This file is NOT a donor key and NOT a preserve-only user mod.
Default level OFF: no log output, so deterministic captures and all gates are byte-identical to before.
Set level to ERROR | WARN | INFO | DEBUG | TRACE to emit progressively more [C3LOG] lines to stdout.
Environment C3_LOG_LEVEL overrides this file (e.g. C3_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG). Never commit a non-OFF level.
Logging is print-only: it changes no value, gate, timing, RNG stream, capture frame or parity state.
